entity.summary: Non-custodial Crypto.com wallet ecosystem formerly branded Crypto.com DeFi Wallet and rebranded to Crypto.com Onchain in 2024.
entity.notes: First-party material explicitly preserves Crypto.com DeFi Wallet continuity into the Crypto.com Onchain rebrand on 2024-11-20. The rebrand date is not treated as the original wallet launch date.

products.summary: Current Crypto.com Onchain browser extension for non-custodial multichain wallet management.
products.notes: Selected as the breadth-pass product boundary. Mobile and other Onchain wallet surfaces are distinct distribution/runtime products and are deferred. The 2025 extension revamp is not treated as the original extension launch.

events.title: Crypto.com DeFi Wallet became Crypto.com Onchain
events.description: Crypto.com announced a new Crypto.com Onchain identity for its existing non-custodial DeFi Wallet lineage.
events.notes: This records brand continuity only. It is not treated as a new wallet or selected-product launch.

evidence.title: Introducing Crypto.com Onchain: The New and Improved DeFi Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party announcement explicitly renames Crypto.com DeFi Wallet to Crypto.com Onchain and describes Onchain as non-custodial.

evidence.title: Introducing the New Crypto.com Onchain Extension
evidence.notes: First-party product update confirms the active non-custodial Onchain browser extension and distinguishes mobile and desktop wallet surfaces.

evidence.title: Introducing Crypto.com Onchain: The New and Improved DeFi Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Crypto.com announcement says the existing DeFi Wallet received a new identity as Crypto.com Onchain and continues as the non-custodial wallet product.

evidence.title: Crypto.com Onchain
evidence.notes: Current first-party help collection contains active Crypto.com Onchain Extension setup, import, swap and wallet-management documentation; Crypto.com also published a revamped extension in 2025. Supports active maintenance, without inferring the original extension launch date.
